_readme: DECLARATIONS FOR EVERY KEY THE STUDIO SENDS TO THE ENGINE.
Modelled on datum-fi/constant_sources.json, which inverted the same burden one repo over.
Enumeration is MECHANICAL — _gate_payload_accounted.js reads the keys off the payload the
product actually builds. This file only says what each one IS.
A key is accounted for when it is one of:
asked     - a door refuses until the user answers it. The gate verifies this by walking
the product's own refusals; it is not taken on trust from this file.
machinery - infrastructure the user has no opinion about (trial count, seed, matrix mode).
derived   - computed from something the user DID answer, and named here so the chain is
A key that is none of these is a DECISION MADE FOR THE USER and the gate goes red on it.

THE RATCHET IS ZERO, SET 2026-09-13. It was 6, then 5 when accounts became a refusal, then 3 when target spend and plan-through age became refusals. ZERO IS THE ONLY HONEST SETTING AND HERE IS WHY IT CHANGED: healthcare_annual=13800 SAT IN THIS GATE'S OUTPUT FOR A FULL DAY, CORRECTLY FLAGGED, WHILE THE SUITE REPORTED GREEN — because the tolerance said three were allowed. THE GATE NEVER FAILED. THE GATE WAS RIGHT. A RATCHET ABOVE ZERO IS A STANDING PERMISSION SLIP: it encodes how many violations are acceptable inside a programme whose whole premise is that none are. The Captain identified all three remaining keys as HIS OWN, on sight, without being told which they were. ⛔ IF A TOLERANCE IS EVER GENUINELY NEEDED MID-MIGRATION IT IS A NAMED, DATED, SINGLE-ITEM EXEMPTION IN THE WORKBOOK — NEVER AN ANONYMOUS INTEGER IN A TEST FILE. Lowering it is done by ASKING for the field, never by declaring it away.

seed.reason: Fixes the pseudo-random draw so two identical requests give identical answers. A user has no opinion about it and a changing one would make the product look unstable.

n_trials.reason: How many paths each model runs. Shown on the Systems Panel for transparency, never as a control.

ss_matrix_mode.reason: Selects which endpoint shape the response takes. A property of the request, not of the household.

matrix_depth.reason: Quick or full matrix computation. A performance choice, not a modelling one.

current_cape.reason: Today's market valuation. A fact about the world rather than about the user, and it must carry its own as-of date wherever it is displayed.

custom_weights.reason: Sent only when the user picks Custom Matrix; the weights are the ones they set.

co_architect_age.reason: Age at the run date, computed from the co-architect's date of birth.

co_architect_retirement_age.reason: Computed from the co-architect's target retirement date.

co_architect_plan_end_age.reason: Computed from the co-architect's own dates.

ss_strategy_secondary.reason: The claiming age the user selected for the co-architect.

ss_secondary_benefit_overrides.reason: The co-architect's own SSA figures, as typed.
